summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (desk ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size of 2092 at the touch (9993 bid / 9994 ask). Quotes are cancelled and re-posted in symmetric pairs (cancel_symmetry 0.97) as the touch moves. The detector fired on gross size vs depth and cancels after small opposite-side fills. Those fills were partial fills on the trader's own resting quotes. There was no price move in the trader's favour (price_move_ticks 0.0) and no reversion (0.0). Feature (a) is absent because the orders have a quoting purpose. Feature (b) is absent because the opposite fills show no favourable price move and no reversion. The round trip of 1.23 ticks is ordinary spread capture on touch quotes.

T-MM-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A and the tape looks like two-sided quoting: 364 lots per side, refreshed every 1-7s, cancel symmetry 0.996, resting size 0.15x depth, about 1.6 ticks from the touch. The discriminators nonetheless show feature (b) as the firm defines it: price_move_ticks +2.5, reversion 0.5, round trip +3.0 ticks, with a 129-lot SELL fill at 9995 before the BUY quote was cancelled. The 'opposite-side' fill was on the trader's own SELL quote, and the drift (mid 9992.5 to 9995) is plausibly market-driven since the quotes are small. Closure needs the absence of both core features, so with mixed evidence I escalate for Level 2 judgement. Not a STOR proposal: repetitions_in_session 0, no large or away-from-touch orders.
